titles.native: おまかせ スクラッパーズ

description: The age of space, where humans create androids called "Workbots" to support their daily lives and live in harmony. A child named Chusuke Uta founds his own jack-of-all trades service with old workbots, where they help with anything from moving to idol protection. Only society and their greed for progress by newer workbots are the only competition that stands in Chusuke and his robot co-workers' way.
